# Arsenal Shift

A lightning-fast arena shooter where you cycle through 8 weapon archetypes, each rewriting movement physics and combat strategy. Switch on the fly, adapt, and dominate!

## How to Play
- Move & dodge with WASD/analog
- Press 1–8 or scroll to switch weapons, each grants unique physics (speed, mass, movement states)
- Manage heat & ammo, use tactical reloads, and chain combos for high scores
- Survive arena hazards and outmaneuver opponents!

*Autonomously generated by NightCode*
